reviews.text:
Dear Worth Street Veterinary Center Team,
Thank you so much for your exceptional competence, warmth, and the loving care you showed Nina. We truly appreciate how professionally you honored all our contracted services.

A special thank you to Nick for being our main point of contact and managing everything so seamlessly, and to Dr. Mitchell Green for his incredible patience, dedication, and the wonderfully affectionate way he treated Nina. We are so grateful to the whole team!

Warmly,
Rogério Souza

I took my dog here for a checkup. They said nothing wrong all good. Then I happened to go to another vet of mine on the UWS and she had to do a gland extraction because she said my dogs glands were really backed up almost about to burst. Why did the worth street vet not check my pet’s glands? It’s a standard check! Overlooking something that obvious should grant a refund even but I’m letting it go.
I love Dr. DiPolo. He's a great & compassionate vet. I've been using him for many years & wouldn't go anywhere else.

We’ve been going to WSVC since 2016 and they were our go-to vet for a long time. We trusted them with our dogs and really valued the relationship we had with the practice. Over time, a few experiences affected that trust and I started to feel less of the personal connection and engagement I would expect as a long-time client. I’m still grateful for the care they provided over the years, but sadly I don’t feel the same about the practice anymore.
Great care as always. Love worth street vet
A little bit pricey, but the services here are very good. Everyone is professional and friendly. The doctor explained options in detail and very patiently.

I have been taking our golden retriever there for several years.  I have found all the vets and tech's to be exceptional.  Especially with follow up.  Our just had CCL surgery which if you have had a dog go through this you well know its a commitment for recovery.   However, they (especially Patti M) have been great with asking questions etc.  Ali is now 10 and we have moved couple times.   They are the best care she has ever received.
Great staff, always helpful and very knowledgeable.

Just wanted to share my experience here to save someone the same experience. It’s been many, many years but I see it is still the same practitioners. I took my 6 month old warm and friendly cat here to get spayed. When I picked her up, she was ferocious, hissing, growling, and shaking. I asked if everything went Okay and they said it did.

After this experience, she has been traumatized and is aggressive, growling, and hissing at anyone that she does not know. The vet even told me that I couldn’t come back after a follow up, because she was climbing up the walls and scaring his staff but it was clearly something they did that caused the transformation in her behavior. A neighbor of mine also had a similar experience with their cat at this vet.

She has never gotten over this experience now YEARS later and it takes her 2-3 months to warm up to new people as everyone is now perceived as a threat. I’m assuming maybe she felt the procedure and that’s where the PTSD formed, but I will never know because they never told me and my cat was never the same after her visit here. This one visit has affected her entire life.

UPDATE to response: I did email the office in the past to let them know I would not be returning because they traumatized my cat. I continuously experience reactions from my animal even 10 years later because of their handling during her spaying. Sorry, but it’s pretty clear that a bad visit from even 10 years ago can affect a pet forever. There wasn’t Google Reviews at the time. There is now, it’s fresh in my mind daily.
We truly appreciate the high rating, Angela!

Amazing staff! Everyone is friendly, compassionate, and genuinely cares about the animals. I always feel my pet is in the best hands, and the team takes the time to answer my questions, explain everything clearly, and make every visit as stress-free as possible. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team they can truly trust.
We truly appreciate the high rating, Alex!

Dr. Sieger is the best! Came in expecting to have to commit to full dental work and she was very honest in letting me know we didn't need to go that route which saved me a lot of stress and unnecessary money. The help text line was also very helpful and responsive answering all of my questions beforehand.
Worth street vet is amazing. They are lovely, knowledgeable and easy to communicate with! Wouldn't go anywhere else for Bella :)
Loyal customer for 10+ years. WSVC always takes great care of our dogs—and us. They’re lovely people who are amazing at what they do.

My dogs have been coming here for years. We’ve moved to other neighborhoods, countries, and we always come back to Worth Street.

The team EQ is high (they’re sensitive to a stressed pet parent - shout out to Aryn and Gillian), they helped me navigate the later years (and grief following the loss of) my 15 y/o “soul dog” Olivia, and the vets are patient and talented. My new dog goes here and sees Dr. Green. He’s great - smart and thorough - and she just had an easy spay surgery with him. They’re great with short nosed dogs and mixed bag rescues.

I’ve had a great experience with Worth Street Vet. The entire team is friendly, kind, and genuinely cares about the wellbeing of every pet.

Dr. Boulting is wonderful. She always takes the time to explain everything clearly, answer all of my questions, and never makes me feel rushed. It’s really sweet how happy she is to see my dog Maya every time. It’s obvious that she truly loves animals. I always feel confident that my dog is receiving excellent care.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, caring, and trustworthy veterinarian.
Our go to for our beanu beans. Great vets who take the time to explain everything. Highly recommend

Dr. Stern is the best! She covers all bases. The front desk tries their best to get you in and answer all questions (very responsive via email). The vet techs are so patient (even with squirmy dogs that refuse to stay still for a BP reading!).
Thank you so much for the great rating, Flor!

Dr. Boulting is incredible. She didn’t try to sell me into everything or add more to my list—she informed us exactly what our pup needed.

We’ve gone here for the past 3 years & I always feel like I’m getting the best care for my pup.
Thank you so much for the high rating, Steve!
We truly appreciate the wonderful review, Carol!
We love how you take care of our Piper. Thank you!

My experience here has been consistently frustrating due to disorganization and lack of follow-through. I would only come here for basic services like vaccines, but I would not rely on them for time sensitive or more serious medical concerns.

In multiple instances, I had to manage and chase down my dog’s care myself, especially when it came to test results. After one visit, I called to follow up on testing and was told the vet I saw was part-time and wouldn’t be back until the following week. When I expressed that I simply needed the results regardless of who delivered them, the conversation shifted inappropriately. I was given personal information about the vet’s situation, which was not relevant to my request, instead of a solution.

This pattern repeated across visits. I don’t need a specific vet to follow up with me. I just need timely communication so I can make informed medical decisions for my dog. Unfortunately, the lack of organization and accountability made it more work than it was worth, despite my efforts to give this place multiple chances.

Is this the last independent veterinary office in NYC?  I don't know but I so appreciate all the personal attention from everyone in this practice. Its easy to get an appointment and I haven't met an employee who doesn't love animals. Sure, it's expensive. But what NYC vet isn't?
We truly appreciate the high rating, Phoebe!

I have a Pittie so I’m always anxious about how she’ll behave in the office, but the staff was so warm and professional that she was able to get her needs taken care of without any problems. It truly means so much to me. We’ve always been patients here, and this is exactly why!
I really love this place , the staff and doctors really care about your animals, I never wait long to be seen and doctor is very knowledgeable

Care and communication are consistently top notch across the entire team, everything from general check-ups, to dental health recommendations and post-op medication instructions. They understand visiting the vet is stressful and make your pet’s comfort a priority. Special thanks to Dr. Carbonell for her patience and care with my anesthesia concerns.

When I met with this new doctor yesterday, I was made aware of previous bad bacteria results found in Chloe’s last fecal test from Jan that I was never sent or told about. Not sure why this was never sent to me considering I paid a large sum for these results. I was told the fecal test came back normal. She didn’t need the antibiotic in my opinion because she no longer had any lingering issues to my knowledge. I also spoke to this doctor about some growths on Chloe and she made me aware of some tests that are available to test them for cancer which I was never made aware of prior. Strange considering I’ve been a client since 2018. I feel like I get different information depending on which doctor I see and that’s frustrating. My doctor has changed several times throughout my time coming to Worth and I really want to see someone who truly knows Chloe. Every time she is sick, we see someone different so the one time a year that she sees Dr. Green means he barely knows her at all. This is upsetting to me as a dog mom. I feel I spend more time with the techs than the actual doctors. I also don’t love that they aren’t open on weekends. It makes it really difficult when there is an issue and I’ve had to go to emergency centers in these instances. Everyone is typically very nice and I’m hesitant to switch vets but it’s very upsetting and frustrating when things happen like not receiving results I paid for.

I have been taking my (now 2yr old) Frenchie to Dr. Green since he was 8 weeks old. Besides being extremely knowledgeable, Dr. Green always offers multiple solutions and perspectives to any of our questions or concerns. He has always been reliable, thorough, supportive, and beyond informative in all of our interactions. I wish more doctors would lead by his example, as genuine care is hard to come by in this industry. Your pup will love him! And as an owner, you will feel at ease to have a skilled doctor that you can trust - and easily reach. Thank you WSVC!
Thank you for the great rating, Guli!

I’m a longtime client who recently returned to NYC from LA and started bringing my new dog to Worth Street. This clinic is truly the best in New York. The veterinarians are exceptionally caring, patient, and clearly experts at what they do.

I tried a few other practices closer to my neighborhood, including Small Door, but the level of care did not compare. It’s absolutely worth the extra 20 minutes to bring my dog here.

My 2‑year‑old, 7‑lb (slightly overweight) chihuahua, Sam, recently saw Dr. Sieger for a checkup and shots, who was wonderful, and then had his first dental with Dr. Carbonell, who was incredible. I was very nervous about him going under anesthesia and asked for a lot of accommodations—like meeting the doctor beforehand and getting updates before any decisions were made about extractions. Many vets might have found that annoying or overbearing, but Dr. Carbonell and the entire staff treated both Sam and me with such kindness and compassion, taking the time to answer questions and explain everything thoroughly.

I really can’t recommend them highly enough. Thanks, Worth Street Team!

My kitty fumbled a jump and broke his canine and jaw. I called WSVC in a panic. Lucky me, they were able to squeeze me in and I saw Dr Carbonell, who gently and thoroughly examined my baby. She then talked me through the options we have including surgery with her or potentially surgery with a specialist on cat dentist as well as the likely tradeoffs.

Overall, I really appreciate her and I can tell that she and the staff here really love the animals they care for. I'm excited to say that I'll be coming back for as long as I'm in the neighborhood.
We truly appreciate the high rating, Barbara!

We’ve trusted them with caring for our Vizsla since he was a tiny puppy and oh my gosh! We always receive the best care, service, and advice (especially for us first-time pup parents who freak out over everything lol). Thank you for always being there for us!

We had an amazing experience with this veterinary office for my puppy’s cherry eye surgery. From the very beginning, the entire team was incredibly informative and reassuring both before and after the surgery. Throughout the entire process, they made sure to check up on both me and my puppy and provided all the necessary medications and clear instructions, which made everything feel much less stressful.
Everyone — from the front desk staff to the vet techs, assisting staff, and the doctor — was so kind, patient, and genuinely loving toward my puppy.
Dr. Francisco DiPolo is truly exceptional. You can immediately tell how knowledgeable he is and how much he genuinely cares about animals. When he first met my puppy, he even got down on the floor to examine him, which instantly built trust and showed how compassionate he is.
It’s now been 3 months since the surgery with no relapse at all. My puppy looks better than ever — you would never even know he had surgery or any eye issues in the first place. I’m extremely grateful for the care we received and would highly recommend Dr. DiPolo and his entire team to anyone looking for compassionate, skilled veterinary care.

We fostered and eventually adopted a dog that had distemper and was paralyzed from it. Of the several vets we took him to, Dr. DiPolo was the only one who not only didn't advise us to put him down, but gave us a physical therapy plan and meds that got him on the right track to being fully ambulatory again against all odds. Our boy is now a fully healthy, happy, normal dog in huge part thanks to Dr DiPolo.

I recently took my 5-year-old dog, Panda, to Worth Vet for his first dental cleaning, and it reminded me why we’ve trusted them since he was a puppy. Patti answered all my anesthesia questions beforehand and really put me at ease. After the procedure, Dr. Green explained the results clearly and even addressed another non-dental concern I had.

The vets here always take their time, explain things well, and Panda’s treatments and vaccinations have all gone smoothly so far. The staff is kind, organized, and always follows up after visits. Nick, their travel specialist, was also a huge help when we traveled to Europe. He walked me through the USDA paperwork, and now Panda has an EU passport.

Worth Vet has been a dependable part of Panda’s care. I highly recommend them!
